title: Test plan
description: Output of the test-architect role: what it changed in .forecrew/matrix.yaml and .forecrew/test-strategy.md, and why.

name.description: Name of an axis, suite or environment as in the matrix.

summary.description: The test strategy in a few sentences; it becomes the pull request description.

axes.description: Every axis of the matrix as you leave it, with why it exists. An empty list only for a matrix without axes.

reason.description: What a failure only this axis can show, e.g. path separators differ on windows.

matrix_changes.description: Every change you made to .forecrew/matrix.yaml, one entry per changed part. Empty when the matrix is unchanged.

part.description: The top-level key of the matrix the change is in.

name.description: What changed: an axis, suite or environment name, or the cell, e.g. os=windows,db=postgres-16.

reason.description: Why, in one or two sentences.

open_questions.description: Questions only a human can answer, e.g. which database versions must be supported; the test plan gate shows them.
